sum: A memory layer with one API to add, retrieve, edit and delete, structured as a graph that a person can inspect and edit rather than an opaque embedding store.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: self-hostable, the state leaves the machine but the operator can own the service; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T1/T6 introduced, controls memval part, log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format store: a store the tool owns; what survives removal depends on an export path
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself, but self-hostable means its state reaches a service, and no egress control is recorded
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: apps/memos-local-plugin/docs/DEMO_TaskCLI_OpenClaw_test.md (--timeout )
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, OpenCode (apps/openwork-memos-integration/CLAUDE.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: src/memos/cli.py (argparse)
evidence.rl.resume: recovering is described in prose, not implemented: apps/memos-local-plugin/docs/DEMO_TaskCLI_OpenClaw_test.md (checkpoint)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/memos-local-plugin-publish.yml (sha256sum)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx @)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: OLLAMA (pyproject.toml)
evidence.sf.stop: it can be stopped, but what the working tree looks like afterwards is not described: apps/MemOS-Cloud-OpenClaw-Plugin/index.js (AbortController)

pre: a place to run the store
a harness with a memory hook, or the SDK called directly
anti: work that fits in one session
cases where a plain file in the repository is enough
gnote: Inspectable and editable by design is a claim almost nothing else at this layer makes, and it is the difference between memory a reviewer can correct and memory that can only be deleted. Deletion being a first-class operation matters for the same reason.

ja.sum: 追加・取得・編集・削除を単一APIで扱う記憶層。不透明な埋め込みストアではなく、人が確認して直せるグラフとして構造化されている。
ja.art: 点検可能な記憶グラフ（永続）
pre: 記憶フックを持つハーネス、またはSDKの直接呼び出し
anti: リポジトリ内の素のファイルで足りる場合
ja.gnote: 「設計として点検・編集できる」という主張は、この層で他にほとんど例がない。レビュアが直せる記憶と、消すことしかできない記憶の差である。削除が一級の操作である点も同じ理由で重要。
